name: Clozapine N-oxide
summary: Clozapine N-oxide (CNO) is a synthetic drug used mainly in biomedical research as a ligand to activate Designer Receptors Exclusively Activated by Designer Drugs (DREADDs), despite the initial belief that it was biologically inert. However, it has been shown to not enter the brain after administration and to reverse metabolize in peripheral tissues to form clozapine.

pharmacology.text: Clozapine N-oxide (CNO) is a synthetic drug used mainly in biomedical research as a ligand to activate Designer Receptors Exclusively Activated by Designer Drugs (DREADDs), despite the initial belief that it was biologically inert. Clozapine can bind to a number of different serotonergic, dopaminergic and adrenergic receptors within the brain.

uses.text: Clozapine N-oxide (CNO) is a synthetic drug used mainly in biomedical research as a ligand to activate Designer Receptors Exclusively Activated by Designer Drugs (DREADDs), despite the initial belief that it was biologically inert.

fact.en: For years scientists treated CNO as an inert switch for designer receptors. In 2017 researchers showed that the body turns some of it back into clozapine, which enters the brain and does the actual switching.
fact.zh: 多年來，科學家把 CNO 當作啟動設計受體的惰性開關。2017 年研究人員發現，身體會把部分 CNO 轉回氯氮平，而真正進入大腦、啟動受體的是氯氮平。
fact.zhHans: 多年来，科学家把 CNO 当作启动设计受体的惰性开关。2017 年研究人员发现，身体会把部分 CNO 转回氯氮平，而真正进入大脑、启动受体的是氯氮平。
